Under the keeper the guard corrects -92 MW of latent phantom CC capacity across 3 plants (two real phantom fixes + one 16 MW clip); its isolated dispatch effect is within noise (no-guard control at the identical code base: maxabs $6.56/MWh, mean $0.06, IDENTICAL C3c tail). governance.note: Delta vs pjm-107 is two hygiene legs, both zero-DOF. (A) EIA-860 CC summer-capacity guard: a measured EIA-860 nameplate schema bound applied in the shared loader; flag-off it reconciles six PJM CC plants (-972 MW) and the corresponding incomplete-nameplate plants in every other ISO (reported, not solved). (B) CT-only CEMS bench flag: scorer-side, scores plants whose EIA-923 net > 1.1x CAMPD gross (physically impossible for a complete record) on their 923 monthly row; class gates untouched (volErr already 923-based). SOLVE DECISION: the guard is NOT byte-identical under the keeper (it fixes a latent phantom-capacity bug), so the full pjm-107 recipe was re-solved (2023-2025, one bundle). Rule-22 LOO is vacuous (zero free parameters). ABLATION TWIN NOT RUN: the owner dropped the zero-forcing-twin requirement 2026-07-14 (time-consuming, not a fit-mover away from frontier; the guard is zero-DOF so the twin is byte-identical to pjm-107's). BOUND: the guard clips New Covert (55297) to nameplate 1176 MW, 16 MW below its CAMPD demonstrated peak 1192.4 — a chartered proper-cc-capacity-reconcile follow-on (docs/handoffs/pjm-cc-capacity-reconcile-2026-07.md).
governance.residuals_note: Honest fit record vs pjm-107 (same scorer, current main code base): every load-bearing criterion identical — C1 16/16 PASS, C2 PASS, C3a PASS, C3b PASS, C5a PASS — plus C4 PASS, C7 PASS, C8 PASS. The 6h->17h shift vs the COMMITTED pjm-107 metrics is the code-base evolution between pjm-107's d62dc6a solve and current main (PJM accreditation R1-R6 + MISO merges), not the guard. Keeper on structural fidelity (rule 1/11: a fleet with no phantom CC capacity beats one carrying it); determination NOT-YET on the C3c boundary, same as pjm-107.
